practice.appHint: A self-contained HTML fragment. Call window.scibly.submit(work) when the learner is done — an exploratory scene skips submit entirely.
practice.solutionHint: Answer key, keyed by the field ids submit(work) sends. Leave empty for an exploratory scene that needs no submit.
practice.explanationHint: Shown to the learner under the app with their result, whatever they scored.
practice.testRunHint: The real sandboxed app. Submitting inside it grades against your draft solution.
practice.saveFailed: Couldn't save your last change. Nothing is lost — keep editing and it retries.
practice.validated: Ready to publish — nothing is missing from this app.
practice.solutionEmpty: Empty — the scene awards full SP on any submit.
practice.gradingFailed: Grading failed. Submit inside the app again to retry.
practice.gradingEmpty: Submit inside the app above to grade it against your solution. Exploratory scenes never submit — nothing lands here.
practice.ungradedScene: Ungraded scene — every submit awards the full SP.
